children: Canton Network hosts an X Space on 3 November 2026 at 2pm ET to discuss the Universal Burn and Synchronizer Pricing changes detailed in CIP-0129. The discussion features CIP-0129 co-authors @Naperian_e and @ShaulKfir, with @Viv_Diwakar of the Canton Foundation moderating the session.
CIP-0129 concerns forthcoming changes to the token's supply and pricing mechanics. The session provides an opportunity to hear the co-authors explain those changes.
We pushed back yesterday's space for a longer session and more community Q&A.
👥 Co-authors of the Universal Burn and Synchronizer Pricing CIP (CIP-0129),

title: Canton: hosts Universal Burn and Synchronizer Pricing discussion - 03 Nov 2026
